outcome: Body weight gain of pregnant rats
cohort: Pregnant SD rats intravenously injected with honokiol microemulsion from day 6-15 of gestation.
finding: Honokiol microemulsion exhibited embryo-fetal developmental toxicity, including decreased fetal body and tail length, at a dose level of 2000 mcg/kg/day, while no adverse effects were observed at doses up to 600 mcg/kg/day.
gest_age: Exposure from day 6-15 of gestation; assessment on gestation day 20
